mapper.insert: insert into global_setting (house_id, user_id, aphrodisiac_days, palpation_days, prepartum_days, weaning_days, postpartum_days, sale_days, replacement_days, remark, create_by, update_by) values (#{houseId}, #{userId}, #{aphrodisiacDays}, #{palpationDays}, #{prepartumDays}, #{weaningDays}, #{postpartumDays}, #{saleDays}, #{replacementDays}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, #{updateBy})
mapper.select: select id, house_id, user_id, aphrodisiac_days, palpation_days, prepartum_days, weaning_days, postpartum_days, sale_days, replacement_days, remark, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from global_setting where user_id = #{userId} limit 1

select gs.id, gs.house_id, gs.user_id, gs.aphrodisiac_days, gs.palpation_days, gs.prepartum_days, gs.weaning_days, gs.postpartum_days, gs.sale_days, gs.replacement_days, gs.remark, gs.create_by, gs.create_time, gs.update_by, gs.update_time from house_users hu join rabbit_houses h on h.id = hu.house_id and h.is_deleted = false join global_setting gs on gs.house_id = h.id where hu.user_id = #{userId} order by hu.is_admin desc, h.id asc, gs.id asc limit 1

select id, house_id, user_id, aphrodisiac_days, palpation_days, prepartum_days, weaning_days, postpartum_days, sale_days, replacement_days, remark, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from global_setting where house_id = #{houseId}
mapper.update: update global_setting set aphrodisiac_days = #{aphrodisiacDays}, palpation_days = #{palpationDays}, prepartum_days = #{prepartumDays}, weaning_days = #{weaningDays}, postpartum_days = #{postpartumDays}, sale_days = #{saleDays}, replacement_days = #{replacementDays}, remark = #{remark}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where user_id = #{userId}
